data.narrative:
Tekever is a Series C-stage autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $631M+ to date. The comparable universe consists of six private companies operating in the same sector, including Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air; no public peers exist in this specific niche.

The Stage-Progression method is the applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. Using total capital raised of $631M as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C-to-subsequent-stage step-ups yields an implied valuation of $1.1B. A peer-median approach was not viable—while five same-sector peers exist, the narrow filters of same stage, adjacent stage, and similar valuation tier yielded fewer than the three datapoints required for statistical credibility.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $912M (low) to $1.2B (high), with a median point of $1.1B. This range reflects the limited methodological foundation (one method) and the absence of a sufficiently populated comparable set at Tekever's specific stage and capital profile. Key uncertainties include the appropriate stage-progression multiple in an early-stage autonomous systems market, relative competitive positioning within the peer set, and unit economics not captured in raised capital alone. Additional financial metrics or transaction data from the peer set would strengthen confidence in this estimate.
